title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection | Flat Troll Blue | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add a dedicated place to hang robes and towels with this wall mount robe hook, crafted from brass and made to coordinate with the Malibu collection in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Brass construction for a sturdy everyday hook
  • Color-coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Assembled in the USA

Specs

  • Category: Robe Hooks
  • Collection: Malibu
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 2 in L x 2 in H x 2.64 in W
  • Projection: 2.64 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 0.5 lb
  • Screw size: 6
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finish options to help match other versatile bath accessories in the Malibu collection.
